list: Official 55 trophies, 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned (Exophase, cross-checked 18 Nov 2026; corroborated by KeenGamer, OutputLag and eGamers, 20 Nov 2026). Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; every guide below is written for this atlas, in our own words, and names its sources.

trophies.guide: What to do: earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own [2]. Where and how: there is no separate task — work the roadmap in order (story first, then side strands, then the long count-based grinds) and the platinum is the last thing you collect [2]. Missable: no, it cannot be missed; it only waits for the other 54 [2].

trophies.disputeShort: live entries: finish 100% before the final mission; our guide: no cutoff
trophies.guide: What to do: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist [1]. Where and how: the checklist covers the story, side strands, activities, collectibles and challenges — in practice, finishing this atlas's other 53 trophies gets you most of the way there, and the game's own 100% screen shows exactly what is left [2]. Do the count trophies (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles, 50 challenges, all shooting-range golds) before the final push, since they are the usual stragglers [2]. Missable: no, but it is the longest grind in the list — both PowerPyx and GTABase rank it the hardest trophy [1][2].

trophies.guide: What to do: complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the tally [1]. Where and how: stunts stack up naturally while driving and riding around Leonida; chase the tally deliberately on long highway runs and off-road jumps, switching vehicles to keep the stunt types varied [2]. The game's stunt counter shows your running total, so check it between sessions [2]. Missable: no — stunts can be done at any time after the opening [1].

trophies.guide: What to do: meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, for both Jason and Lucia [1]. Where and how: meditation spots are marked as you find them; sit and complete the meditation at each one, checking the count as you go so none is left half-done [2]. Missable: YES — the only trophy both PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable [1][2]. The first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and becomes unavailable after that chapter ends, so meditate there before finishing Chapter 1, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and do not rely on mission replay (there is none) [1].
